function: Learned end-to-end receiver (FCNN) that directly detects the SMBM symbol, transmit-antenna index and RF-mirror bits from received samples, without channel estimation (p. 1, 3).
system: SMBM-MIMO, Nt=4 transmit antennas (one active), Nr=4 receive (Nr=1 for QPSK case), Nrf=2 RF mirrors per transmit antenna; frequency band not stated; no RIS (p. 4).
method: Fully connected DNN with two hidden layers (150, 75 nodes), ReLU, softmax cross-entropy; supervised offline training with one-hot labels, Adam, mini-batches; 7 million training samples (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Simulated Rayleigh-fading channel with AWGN, samples generated by the authors; no standard channel model, measurement or public dataset (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Same simulated Rayleigh SMBM setup (Nt=4, Nr=4, Nrf=2) for training and testing; BER over SNR; no unseen channel, antenna number or modulation test (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: ML receiver with LMMSE channel estimation (I-CSI), ML receiver with perfect CSI, and theoretical ABEP bounds; no learned baseline (p. 3-4).
metrics: Average bit error rate versus SNR for BPSK, QPSK, 8-PSK, 16-QAM; theoretical ABEP; complex multiplications and additions (p. 3-5).
complexity: Table I counts complex multiplications and additions of the DNN receiver per layer, with totals as functions of layer widths N1-N4; training cost ignored (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "contains Rayleigh distributed channel fading coefficients between all transmit and receive antennas". Missing: no standardized model or measured data; custom Rayleigh simulator.
q2_support: p. 4: "no difference in performance between the training and test sets". Missing: no test in a scenario, antenna number, modulation or channel unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 4: "is compared with an ML receiver with LMMSE channel estimation and P-CSI". Missing: no earlier learned detector or other learned architecture is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "the total number of CMs and CAs is given in the last row of the table" (Table I, complex multiplications and additions).
q5_support: p. 4: "we use 7 million samples for training". Missing: samples are self-generated, with no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: Area 1: the DNN replaces channel estimation plus ML detection, and the metric is BER (p. 1, 3). ris=0: the RF mirrors of media-based modulation sit at the transmit antenna and encode index bits, and the paper does not call them a RIS (p. 2); reviewer to confirm. For 16-QAM the DNN BER stays above (worse than) the perfect-CSI ML curve (p. 4-5).
